descriptions.w3d_d27e_filter_set_gain_801dcc10: Float property setter of a filter chain: clamps the value to [0, 1], then for ids 17, 18 and 19 finds the first child whose kind (slot 7) is 2, 4 or 1 and forwards the value to its slot 13; returns 1 when the id or the child is unknown. The filter meaning is inferred from the sibling setter 0x801dcdc0.
